> I'm building a custom open-source handheld gaming console powered by an ESP32, featuring a larger TFT display, SD card storage for game ROMs, physical gaming buttons, speaker/audio output, rechargeable battery, and a custom 3D-printed enclosure. I also want to develop my own NES emulator and custom PCB to bring everything together into a portable retro gaming device.
